title: pelargonium exstipulatum
intro: Pelargonium exstipulatum, commonly known as Mountain Rose, is a plant species within the geranium family, known for its medicinal and aromatic properties. The leaves and flowers of this plant are used to prepare infusions and extracts, which offer various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Pelargonium exstipulatum include flavonoids, such as luteolin and apigenin, as well as phenolic acids and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-spasmodic and anti-depressant effects. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium exstipulatum are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress and inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
